address: Asker Ocağı Caddesi No:1, Beyoğlu, Istanbul, 34367, Türkiye
bio: In Maromi, the Divan hotel boasts an excellent sushi restaurant, where you can dine at a regular table or sit at the counter – we highly recommend the latter to watch the chef in action. See how he tucks tender octopus and pickled daikon into a cradle of warm rice, or how he rolls salmon, spring onion and a fiery chilli pepper sauce in a mantle of toasted sesame seeds. Choose your sushi à la carte, or opt for the omakase menu and let the chef decide. On Tuesdays there's even an all-you-can-eat option!
